name: The Phantom of the Opera
source:
When people start dying in the Palais Garnier Opera House, up-and-coming soprano, Christine Daaé finds herself at the center of a dark obsession.
Can Christine break free from the clutches of the Phantom of the Opera?
Or will she remain haunted by him forever?

[From [url=https://orribu.itch.io/phantom-of-the-opera-spooktober2026]itch.io[/url]]
